White Label Senior Living: LinkedIn Ads

The six approved messages in sketch, photo, text-only and modern styles. Ready for manager review.

Manager review 0 approved0 need changes0 not reviewed0 removed Background

Editing is on for every ad. Click any text on an ad, its intro text or its LinkedIn headline to change it. Changes save in this browser as you type. Click Done editing to enlarge ads again.

How this file is organized

Each style below runs all six approved messages word for word, marked New from Boldt.

  1. Type your name in the review bar.
  2. Use Background in the review bar to see the sketch, photo and text-only ads on white, blue or black.
  3. Don't want a whole style? Click Remove this set next to its heading, then click again to confirm.
  4. Click Approve or Needs changes under each ad, and add notes if needed.
  5. To change wording, click Edit text under an ad, then click its graphic text, intro text or LinkedIn headline. Edit all text in the review bar turns editing on for every ad.
  6. Click Remove ad twice to delete an ad from the file. The other ads move up to fill its place, and it stays out of your saved copy.
  7. Everything saves automatically for everyone who opens this page in the dashboard. Download review summary gives a spreadsheet of every decision.

Changes from other reviewers show up on your screen within a few seconds. Your name comes from your dashboard sign-in.

Hover over any ad to see it larger. Click to keep it open, and press Esc to close.
